resources.ref_edit_tooltip: Change the branch tasks work on
resources.ref_error_commit: That's a commit, not a branch. Tasks deliver back to the branch they start from — for a one-off revision, pass --ref to multica repo checkout.

intro.title: Break big work into projects
intro.description: A project groups related issues so you can track them together. Its description and linked repositories go along as context on every agent run.

progress.title: See progress at a glance
progress.description: Status, lead, target date, and completion sit on one card, so you don't have to open every issue.

context.title: Context travels with every run
context.description: Write the description and link repositories once. Every run on the project's issues picks them up.

sidebar.title: Pinned to your sidebar
sidebar.description: Pin the projects you use most to the sidebar, and expand one to see its issues.
